signature: SUBROUTINE DLACON( N, V, X, ISGN, EST, KASE )

params.name: v
params.reference: On the final return, $V = A \, W$, where $\mathrm{EST} = \operatorname{norm}(V)/\operatorname{norm}(W)$ (W is not returned).

params.name: x
params.reference:
On an intermediate return, X should be overwritten by

$$
A \, X, \quad\text{if}\quad \mathrm{KASE}=1
$$

$$
A^T \, X, \quad\text{if}\quad \mathrm{KASE}=2
$$

and DLACON must be re-called with all the other parameters unchanged.

params.name: est
params.reference: On entry with `KASE = 1` or 2 and $\mathrm{JUMP} = 3$, `EST` should be unchanged from the previous call to DLACON. On exit, `EST` is an estimate (a lower bound) for norm(A).

params.name: kase
params.reference: On the initial call to DLACON, `KASE` should be 0. On an intermediate return, `KASE` will be 1 or 2, indicating whether X should be overwritten by $A \, X$ or $A^T \, X$. On the final return from DLACON, `KASE` will again be 0.
